description: MainActivity.kt defines the main screen of the note-taking app, managing the display of notes, search functionality, theme toggling, and navigation to an editing activity.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity displaying a list of notes with search and theme toggle features, and navigation to an edit note screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets theme, layout, toolbar, recyclerView, and loads notes.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reloads notes when resuming the activity.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the repository and updates the list adapter.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu, sets up the search view with query handling.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, notably theme toggling.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Performs search in the repository and updates the list with results.
